title: 第17章 土地全部开荒完毕
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
地被开荒了，剩下的活便轻松许多。

    花期拿出昨天晚上下单的种子，分别交给松松还有荣华，告诉她们如何种植。

    “这一批都是大树冠种子，每一袋种类不同，种植的时候小心别弄混了。”

    “每粒种子间隔三米，一排差不多能种五十多棵树，刚好是一包种子用量，种完就换第二排，直到把所有种子用完。”

    她拿出一把小锄头，特意给两人演示了一遍种植方法。

    还折了一根三米长的树枝定好距离，怕她们不清楚三米是多长。

    荣华和松松同时点头，一人拿着五包不同种类的种子分头行动。

    松松接着在芒果树后面种，拿着棍子找准地方，手脚并用在土上挖出一个坑，随后将种子丢进去，最后用脚踩严实。

    荣华那边同样，她没种过种子，第一次挖地还有点琢磨不好分寸。

    生怕坑挖浅了种子会漏出来，挖深了又怕种子死掉。

    因此前面几次她都比较慢，松松都种到前面去了，她还在起点不远。

    花期也没催，细工出慢活，谨慎点确实好。

    她倒是可以下单自动播种机器，可这样两个员工就没活干了。

    她又不是大善人，员工不干活还包饭，哪里会有这样好的事情。

    这时，机械鼠挖完地了，吱吱吱地回到花期脚边。

    她一把将浑身都是泥巴的机械鼠捞起，牵着尾巴抖了抖，便带着机械鼠回到城主府。

    快递基本都送到了，除了比较远的布料还没到，花期想要的东西差不多齐了。

    她先是将生活机器人给拆开，输入自己的ID，把它和个人终端绑定。

    滴的一声，浑身银色，身体圆滚滚，四肢纤细的机器人被激活。

    它的眼睛浮现银光，将花期的面容录入自己的程序中。

    “主人您好，我是生活机器人，编号PX3333。您可以给我取个名字，或者直接叫我3333。”

    花期随口给它取了一个名字，并下达第一个命令，“以后你叫小花，第一个任务便是将所有快递全部搬进屋内，按照分类整理好。”

    “遵命主人。”

    小花下面的两条腿往上一窜，冒出两个轮子来到快递山旁边。

    胸前的两条机械手臂伸出，钳子般的手掌紧紧抓住一个大型快递，轻松地将它扛在肩上滑入城主府。

    花期在快递中找出复印机，在院子里摊开桌子，拿出笔画‘小芒果’的第二期漫画。

    她画画，小花便在旁边来来回回地搬快递。
content_en:
The land was cleared, and the remaining work became much easier.

    Hua Qi took out the seeds he ordered last night and gave them to Songsong and Ronghua respectively, telling them how to plant them.

    "This batch is all large canopy seeds. Each bag has different types. Be careful not to mix them up when planting."

    "Each seed is spaced three meters apart. One row can plant more than fifty trees, which is exactly the amount needed for one packet of seeds. After planting, switch to the second row until all the seeds are used up."

    She took out a small hoe and specifically demonstrated the planting method to the two of them.

    I also broke a three-meter-long branch to set the distance, in case they didn't know how long three meters was.

    Ronghua and Songsong nodded at the same time, each holding five packets of different types of seeds and moving separately.

    Songsong then planted the seeds behind the mango tree, found the right place with a stick, dug a hole in the soil with his hands and feet, then threw the seeds in, and finally stamped them tightly with his feet.

    The same thing happened to Ronghua. She had never planted seeds before, so she was a little unsure of the right direction when digging the ground for the first time.

    If the pit is dug shallow, the seeds will leak out, and if the pit is dug deep, the seeds will die.

    Therefore, she was slower in the first few times, and Songsong was planted in front, but she was still not far from the starting point.

    There is no rush during the flowering period. Careful work results in slow work, so it is really better to be cautious.

    She could place an order for an automatic seeding machine, but then the two employees would have no work to do.

    She is not a philanthropic person. If the employees do not work but are paid for their meals, how can such a good thing happen?

    At this time, the mechanical mouse finished digging and squeaked back to Hua Qi's feet.

    She picked up the mechanical mouse that was covered in mud, shook it by its tail, and then took the mechanical mouse back to the city lord's mansion.

    The express delivery has basically been delivered. Except for the far away fabrics that have not yet arrived, everything I want during the flower period is almost complete.

    She first took apart the life robot, entered her ID, and bound it to her personal terminal.

    With a beeping sound, the silver-colored robot with a round body and slender limbs was activated.

    Its eyes glowed with silver, and it recorded Huaqi's face into its own program.

    "Hello Master, I am a living robot, number PX3333. You can give me a name, or just call me 3333."

    Hua Qi gave it a name casually and gave it the first order, "From now on, you will be called Xiao Hua. Your first task is to move all the express delivery into the house and organize it according to categories."

    "Obey my master."

    The two legs under Xiaohua jumped up, and two wheels came out and came to the side of the express mountain.

    The two mechanical arms on the chest stretched out, and the plier-like palms tightly grasped a large express delivery, easily carrying it on the shoulders and sliding it into the city lord's palace.

    Hua Qi found the copy machine in the express delivery, spread out the table in the yard, and took out the second issue of the comic with the strokes of "Little Mango".

    She was painting, and Xiaohua was carrying express delivery back and forth beside her.
